name: zdos-kira-online
description: ZDOS-K.I.R.A. online control center with secure server-side AI

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public/index.html')) process.exit(1); fs.mkdirSync('docs',{recursive:true}); for(const f of ['index.html','app.js','styles.css','landing.css','landing.js','config.js','manus-routes.json','kira-logo.svg']) fs.copyFileSync('public/'+f,'docs/'+f);"
